samples.question: The navy workbench contains a reference patch R and candidate patches A and B. Each patch is one connected 3x3 core with four thick seam keys of lengths 1, 2, or 3 grid units, and all three patches have equal total ink. Rotate each candidate patch 90 degrees clockwise. Read the lengths of the up, right, down, and left keys on the transformed patch. Which candidate has exactly the same four-length completion signature as R? Answer with that candidate's marker color.
